definitions.hit: true structure in the top credible set with sign +; unassigned = 0
definitions.chance: members of the top set with sign + / K (prereg 4 amendment 2026-10-14); chance_size = |top set| / K
definitions.excess: hit - chance per query (the chance-corrected hit; gated contrasts use it, prereg 4 amendment 2026-10-14)
definitions.interval: 97.5 % structure-clustered percentile bootstrap, 5000 replicates, RandomState(0) reset per contrast
definitions.arms: per seed, then averaged per condition
definitions.covered: conditions whose structure the package kept
